name: BrandGlyph - Four Ways A Glyph Resolves
description: One glyph alone would not be worth a frame; what this component has to prove is that one piece of markup serves every surface that draws an icon. Four cases side by side: resolved from a social link's icon key, resolved from a label instead the way a CMS-entered channel gets a glyph nobody configured, a generic non-brand mark, and an unresolvable name that must render nothing rather than a gap or a broken mark.
